mapper.insert: INSERT INTO supplier_info (supplier_name, cate_id, credit_code, contact_user, contact_phone, address, qualification, supplier_status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{supplierName}, #{cateId}, #{creditCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{contactUser}, #{contactPhone, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{address, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{qualification, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{supplierStatus, jdbcType=INTEGER}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE supplier_info SET supplier_status = 3, update_time = NOW() WHERE supplier_id = #{supplierId}
mapper.sql: s.supplier_id, s.supplier_name, c.cate_name, s.credit_code, s.contact_user, s.contact_phone, s.address, s.qualification, CASE s.supplier_status WHEN 1 THEN '正常' WHEN 2 THEN '暂停' WHEN 3 THEN '关闭' ELSE '未知' END AS supplier_status_name, s.create_time
